'''Port''', was one of two [[Uvak]] used to steer the [[Airship/Legends|airship]] [[Candra (ship)|''Candra'']]. It was berthed on the left side of the airship, whereas [[Starboard]] was berthed on the right.<ref name="pandemonium" />
